direction: Ancient stone-copper array machinery; completely new designs. Previous pale-jade jewelry and shield silhouettes rejected.
common_style: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single tangible ancient Chinese cultivation array-machine component, a usable piece of Tiangong stone-and-metal craft, NOT a graphic symbol, chess piece, jewel pendant, ornamental badge, magic jewelry or functional UI pictogram. Create one entirely new standalone object; do not reuse any previous pale-jade-and-gold designs. Material language: matte ink-gray dark basalt / black whetstone, small restrained smoke-white chalcedony inserts, oxidized old reddish copper clamps and tiny rivets. Sparse faint rubbed cinnabar wear only in a few joints, not connected lines or inscriptions. Fine Chinese gongbi ink contours and restrained mineral watercolor on actual material surfaces, half-worn hand-filed craftsmanship, thin real structural depth, understated soft light from upper left. Exact straight top-down orthographic view, no isometric tilt, no deep pedestal. A distinctive readable asymmetrical silhouette and mechanically interlocking anatomy; it must look like a compact real ancient instrument rather than a logo. Real opaque stone and copper with clear clean contour, small transparent safety margin, preserve full object. Genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the object and in open cavities; no paper background, white panel, ground plane or baked checkerboard. No text, numerals, symbols, rune writing, arrows, grids, circuit paths, connecting wires, port labels, UI, health bars, magic halo, glow, sparks or outside cast shadow. Avoid polished emerald jewels, large gemstone cabochons, gold filigree frames, symmetric pendant loops, shields, clocks and door iconography. Only the actual one-piece artifact.

assets.name: sensor_1x1.png
assets.label: 听枢
assets.subject: A compact listening pivot (ting-shu): three UNEQUAL slender curved crescent-shaped old-red-copper foils clasp around a single slim smoky-chalcedony sensing needle, each foil anchored by a different small dark basalt heel and tiny copper rivets so it is one working instrument. The open asymmetrical foils have different lengths and bends. No complete outer ring, no crosshair, no compass, no four-axis symmetry, no circular jewel in the center. Square 1:1 footprint, a finely articulated irregular almost triangular tool silhouette.

pcb_redesign.prompt:
Completely redesign the rejected rough-study reference into a precision flat packaged module. Keep only the broad functional idea; rebuild all anatomy, materials finish and camera. Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one miniature precision CULTIVATION ARRAY CIRCUIT MODULE, an ancient stone-ceramic-and-copper equivalent of an expertly packaged CPU/PCB component, ready to mount onto a dark jade circuit base. Exact camera: ORTHOGRAPHIC 90-DEGREE TOP-DOWN PLAN VIEW. We look straight down onto the entire flat top face; NO isometric view, NO 3/4 view, NO visible front or side wall, no tilted perspective, no chunky sculpture. Delicate thickness is shown only by a hairline bevel, narrow cover lips and shallow internal recesses. Manufacture: finely ground dark gray-green ceramic jade, precisely trimmed oxidized reddish-copper cover plates/ribs, tiny flush micro-rivets, one or two SMALL smoke-white marrow/chalcedony inserts. Smooth intact worked surfaces with subtle fine ink-and-mineral-watercolor texture, NO coarse basalt chunks, no fractures, rough stone or rubble. Dark ceramic is one clear step lighter than a charcoal jade circuit board, copper and white core give strong small-scale contrast. Integrate several short fine flat copper contact fingers flush along selected package edges, all visible from above; they are physical pads, not drawn inter-component wires. The module has a compact engineered package, not a free-standing tool, bow, pendant or jewel; distinctive silhouette and internal mechanism readable at 64px. Genuine transparent alpha outside the full object and in deliberate holes; no floor, background, cast shadow, paper card or baked checkerboard. No text, numerals, Chinese writing, logos, UI, grids, labels, arrows, external signal lines, long connecting cables, halo or magic glow. Do not use shield, clock, gate or arrow pictograms. Preserve Chinese cultivation material character rather than modern plastic or a modern branded chip.
Module construction: Listening sensor chip: a compact irregular rounded-triangular ceramic-jade package within a square 1:1 footprint. THREE UNEQUAL thin crescent COPPER SENSING FOILS nest on its shallow top face around a very fine short smoke-white jade needle anchored in the middle. The foils are small internal precision layers, NOT large free-swinging arms. A few short copper contact fingers sit on the package perimeter. No complete round ring, crosshair or compass dial. Small, flat, dense and carefully enclosed; completely abandon the coarse stone-and-copper bow of the rejected study.
Composition: final sprite 128 x 128 pixels, true 128:128 footprint. Fill about 88-94% of both width and height including the short contact pads, leave small transparent safety margin, complete object visible and never stretched.

assets.name: ward_1x2.png
assets.label: 回护双阙
assets.subject: A protective actuator called Huihu Shuangque, an ingenious paired-ridge array machine: TWO ASYMMETRICAL long thin INK-GRAY BASALT ARC RIDGES, one longer and hooked and one shorter and offset, curl around each other head-to-tail. They form an irregular enclosed central working cavity containing a restrained smoke-white chalcedony sliver and tiny old-red-copper pins/clamps, structurally tying the two ridges into one complete vertical mechanism. The silhouette is open, sinuous and not bilaterally symmetric. Its overall object footprint is portrait 1:2, height about twice width, and the actual construction fills this long shape. ABSOLUTELY NOT a shield, heraldic plate, pointed shield outline, leaf pendant, badge, broad solid jade slab or any shield motif. No long full rectangular frame around it. Dark stone ridges dominate; white chalcedony is a small functional material, not a giant jewel.

assets.name: counter_2x1.png
assets.label: 三候鳞台
assets.subject: One complete horizontal stepped counting mechanism, built from THREE thin flattened gray-basalt scale platforms arranged in a staggered rising progression, not in a row of beads. The scale plates differ slightly in height and overlap like three measured mechanical stages, with tiny smoke-white chalcedony insets on their worked surfaces. They are clamped to a SINGLE old-red-copper elongated working spine with small rivets and offset retaining tabs. A clear stepped upper silhouette, a stable horizontal lower spine and a clean broad 2:1 body, more rectilinear and terraced than curved. No spheres, jewels, rollers, abacus, numeral marks, clockwork dial or rectangular jewelry frame. One united flat ancient array mechanism, not three loose stones.

Small stone mounting heels and tiny rivets make it an intact ONE-piece assembled instrument. A strongly OPEN three-lobed silhouette with clearly separated copper wings and small negative gaps, not a symmetric Y, arrow sign, trident, propeller logo or graphic branching diagram. No arrow-shaped tips or drawn connections. One tiny smoke-white chalcedony seam at the inner core, not a large gemstone. Square 1:1 object.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single tangible ancient Chinese cultivation array-machine component, a usable piece of Tiangong stone-and-metal craft, NOT a graphic symbol, chess piece, jewel pendant, ornamental badge, magic jewelry or functional UI pictogram. Create one entirely new standalone object; do not reuse any previous pale-jade-and-gold designs. Material language: matte ink-gray dark basalt / black whetstone, small restrained smoke-white chalcedony inserts, oxidized old reddish copper clamps and tiny rivets. Sparse faint rubbed cinnabar wear only in a few joints, not connected lines or inscriptions. Fine Chinese gongbi ink contours and restrained mineral watercolor on actual material surfaces, half-worn hand-filed craftsmanship, thin real structural depth, understated soft light from upper left. Exact straight top-down orthographic view, no isometric tilt, no deep pedestal. A distinctive readable asymmetrical silhouette and mechanically interlocking anatomy; it must look like a compact real ancient instrument rather than a logo. Real opaque stone and copper with clear clean contour, small transparent safety margin, preserve full object. Genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the object and in open cavities; no paper background, white panel, ground plane or baked checkerboard. No text, numerals, symbols, rune writing, arrows, grids, circuit paths, connecting wires, port labels, UI, health bars, magic halo, glow, sparks or outside cast shadow. Avoid polished emerald jewels, large gemstone cabochons, gold filigree frames, symmetric pendant loops, shields, clocks and door iconography. Only the actual one-piece artifact.
Readability and integrity: designed to read clearly at 64 pixels. The basalt is medium ink-gray with slightly lighter worked planes and crisp edge highlights so the object remains visible against a darker charcoal-stone array board. Copper clamps have a restrained warm old-red tone, and a few small smoke-white chalcedony inserts clarify structure. It is an INTACT precisely fitted functioning array machine, not rubble: no large cracks, torn gaps, missing chunks, fractured ends or excessive distressed damage. Natural fine mineral grain and machining wear only. Maintain distinctly different silhouettes for each component; do not repeat a curved stone bow or pendant.
Subject and physical construction: One compact branching array mechanism: a tightly fitted angular gray-basalt central core anchors THREE broad old-red-copper leaves that unfold outward, each leaf has a different length and bend and a rounded-square worked end. Small stone mounting heels and tiny rivets make it an intact ONE-piece assembled instrument. A strongly OPEN three-lobed silhouette with clearly separated copper wings and small negative gaps, not a symmetric Y, arrow sign, trident, propeller logo or graphic branching diagram. No arrow-shaped tips or drawn connections. One tiny smoke-white chalcedony seam at the inner core, not a large gemstone. Square 1:1 object.
Framing: designed for 128 x 128 pixels, actual object aspect 128:128. Keep the entire object visible, occupying about 86-92% of both the intended width and height, never stretch a square drawing.

pcb_redesign.prompt:
Create a brand-new design; do not imitate any previous coarse stone study. Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one miniature precision CULTIVATION ARRAY CIRCUIT MODULE, an ancient stone-ceramic-and-copper equivalent of an expertly packaged CPU/PCB component, ready to mount onto a dark jade circuit base. Exact camera: ORTHOGRAPHIC 90-DEGREE TOP-DOWN PLAN VIEW. We look straight down onto the entire flat top face; NO isometric view, NO 3/4 view, NO visible front or side wall, no tilted perspective, no chunky sculpture. Delicate thickness is shown only by a hairline bevel, narrow cover lips and shallow internal recesses. Manufacture: finely ground dark gray-green ceramic jade, precisely trimmed oxidized reddish-copper cover plates/ribs, tiny flush micro-rivets, one or two SMALL smoke-white marrow/chalcedony inserts. Smooth intact worked surfaces with subtle fine ink-and-mineral-watercolor texture, NO coarse basalt chunks, no fractures, rough stone or rubble. Dark ceramic is one clear step lighter than a charcoal jade circuit board, copper and white core give strong small-scale contrast. Integrate several short fine flat copper contact fingers flush along selected package edges, all visible from above; they are physical pads, not drawn inter-component wires. The module has a compact engineered package, not a free-standing tool, bow, pendant or jewel; distinctive silhouette and internal mechanism readable at 64px. Genuine transparent alpha outside the full object and in deliberate holes; no floor, background, cast shadow, paper card or baked checkerboard. No text, numerals, Chinese writing, logos, UI, grids, labels, arrows, external signal lines, long connecting cables, halo or magic glow. Do not use shield, clock, gate or arrow pictograms. Preserve Chinese cultivation material character rather than modern plastic or a modern branded chip.
Module construction: Branching module, square 1:1: a SMALL angular ceramic-jade chip housing supports a tight stone-ceramic core, from which THREE unequal very thin COPPER LEAF CONTACT STRUCTURES open outward across its shallow top, all retained inside the compact package footprint. The three copper leaves have different rounded-square ends and small retaining tabs. The package has three subtly stepped outer lobes with SHORT peripheral copper contact fingers, not long projecting arms. One tiny white marrow seam lies at the core. Not a Y, trident, arrow or graphic branch diagram; a real precision module.
Composition: final sprite 128 x 128 pixels, true 128:128 footprint. Fill about 88-94% of both width and height including the short contact pads, leave small transparent safety margin, complete object visible and never stretched.

assets.label: 合脉旋聚枢
assets.subject: One compact gathering array mechanism: THREE interlocked copper-and-basalt curved blades rotate and overlap INWARD, tightly enclosing a small smoke-white chalcedony working nucleus in a recessed central pocket. The outer silhouette is a CLOSED compact irregular rounded triangular knuckle, with unequal metal retaining clamps and clear stone-copper seams. The blades are precise thick fitted machine segments, not flower petals or jewelry. It must look markedly different from a branching component with three spread wings: dense and centripetal, not openly three-pronged. No arrows, circular jewel medallion, complete ornamental ring, yin-yang symbol or graphic spiral symbol. Square 1:1 object.
